# varda-website-serve

Build output of [Varda-Safety/varda-website](https://github.com/Varda-Safety/varda-website), served by GitHub Pages at https://varda-safety.com.

**Do not edit files here.** Everything except this README is replaced on every deploy. To publish a new version, change the source in `varda-website` and run `npm run deploy` there (see its README).
